question: In ________, local thunderstorms are called mango shower which helps in ripening mango crop.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 4**__ i.e __**Kerala**__.

__
 
• The pre-monsoon rains are also known as April rains or summer rains. 
 
• **Mango showers** are the name of the pre-monsoon showers in **Kerala**__ and some parts of Karnataka, these rains help in the early ripening of mangoes. 
 
• They are also known as 'Kaal Baisakhi' in Bengal, as Bardolli Chhera in Assam and as Cherry Blossom showers or Coffee Showers in Kerala.
